_comment: Every tree, boulder and patch in the Age comes out the same shape (Jonah, 2026-10-12): where things grow
is left alone, but each feature is drawn from one seed of the Age's own, so every oak is the same oak.
A random choice inside a feature comes out the same too, so a forest of mixed trees is one kind. Only
ground generated after the Age is written; a sapling grown by hand is its own. Strange, whole at one step.
